{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify premises
valid_loyal = 'LOYAL' in sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()
valid_completed = 'completed' in sales_df['status'].unique()

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Check if any rows were found
n_rows = len(loyal_completed)

valid_loyal, valid_completed, n_rows, mean_revenue"}
